title: Hit-test a schematic click and list component parameters
summary: Picks a point on a schematic sheet (interactively or by coordinates), finds the component there with CreateHitTest and lists its parameters with a child iterator.
phrasings: find the component at a clicked point
ask the user to click on a schematic
read the parameters of a schematic component
what objects are under this location

commands.name: CheckComponentProperty
commands.description: Click a component and list its parameters
commands.params: At=<x,y in mils> (optional; without it the command prompts for a click and only runs from the menu)|Export=true|false (default true)

commands.name: ListComponents
commands.description: List the components on the current sheet (test helper)
